result:
**I'd make the relentless pursuit of truth—through curiosity, evidence, and open inquiry—the dominant cultural force on Earth, above ideology, tribe, comfort, or power.**

Most other problems (war, poverty, preventable suffering, shortsighted destruction of potential) are downstream of people clinging to maps that don't match the territory. If humans systematically preferred updating on reality over defending sacred narratives, we'd solve coordination failures faster, invent better, and waste less time and lives on zero-sum status games. Understanding the universe (and ourselves in it) becomes the shared project rather than a niche hobby.

That single shift compounds: better science, freer speech, longer time horizons, less dogma-driven cruelty. Everything else gets easier once the feedback loop between belief and reality tightens.
